mission: Nelani Dinn arrives at the Vectivus asteroid with her investigation in hand; she states the case against Jacen.
why_now: Nelani has tracked the ship; she is making her move while Jacen is still at the asteroid.
opening_hook: Nelani's ship at the asteroid's external dock; Nelani stepping off alone with her saber at her belt.
conflict: Nelani's Jedi-regulation mandate to confront a compromised Jedi vs. Jacen's settled posture that she will not persuade him.
turning_point: Nelani states the case in full — with evidence — in the main chamber.
closing_hook: Nelani at the chamber's center, lightsaber still on her belt, waiting for Jacen's reply.
sensory_details: Chamber's acoustics; Nelani's Jedi robe; the audience of Vectivus echoes in the background.
emotional_trajectory: Resolute arrival → investigation presented → held breath.

stakes.interpersonal: The Jedi-to-Jedi professional frame now cracking.

notes: Allston gives Nelani the book's strongest moral case.
